connector.name: Waggle
connector.registryDescription: Discover, search, invoke, and rate A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.waggle.zone over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace zone.waggle. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
